sourceMentionCheckLimit: sourceMentionsSetting is a lexical aid only. Product/collection/requireSelection bindings are consumed by the canonical data-binding engine; absence of a direct Liquid mention is not a missing-control verdict.

nicheFacts.canonicalOwner: packages/commerce-core/src/trailmark-facts.ts; existing product/variant editors and atomic catalogue commands
rules: Value and unit form one atomic fact.
Absent variant override inherits the entire common measurement.
Variant dimensions replace the entire group; absent height stays absent.
Clearing last override removes namespace; no empty override object.
No garment-size conversion, invented compatibility or safety certification.
Non-inventory edits omit untouched stock and preserve actual UUIDs.

advertisedCapabilities.name: Navigation, basic search and product identity/INR price/options
advertisedCapabilities.owner: commerce-core / gateway product query / existing navigation and Liquid drops
advertisedCapabilities.requiredProof: Use real public same-site products and supported query fields; server stock and variant identity

advertisedCapabilities.name: Versioned Trailmark composition and exact preview
advertisedCapabilities.requiredProof: Actual package/version survives catalog Add, resource binding, saved draft, signed preview, explicit publication and immutable release; no rewrite of existing ride instances

advertisedCapabilities.name: Typed recreational equipment facts
advertisedCapabilities.owner: shared-types / commerce-core / merchant product editor / public data binding
advertisedCapabilities.requiredProof: Validated bounded namespace, merchant edit/readback, allowlisted safe public Liquid projection; unknown stays unknown; clothing and equipment schemas switch together

advertisedCapabilities.name: Activity, type and measured-size filters/sort
advertisedCapabilities.owner: canonical paginated product query and existing storefront discovery island
advertisedCapabilities.requiredProof: Allowlisted category-specific query contract, indexed pagination, supplied totals, query/back retention and clear-one behavior; omit unsupported controls from production

advertisedCapabilities.name: Technical measurement presentation
advertisedCapabilities.owner: Liquid product facts block under theme-engine
advertisedCapabilities.requiredProof: Written units agree with selected variant; diagram is explicitly illustrative and not to scale; no measurements inferred from AI photo

advertisedCapabilities.name: Compatibility statements
advertisedCapabilities.requiredProof: Source-backed normalized facts or unconfirmed label. No universal matcher or compare engine is advertised

advertisedCapabilities.name: Independent related products
advertisedCapabilities.owner: existing resource bindings and public product drops
advertisedCapabilities.requiredProof: Explicit curated list of same-site public product links; independent prices/stock; no automatic kit or component inventory coupling

advertisedCapabilities.name: Quantity, cart, checkout and mock payment recovery
advertisedCapabilities.owner: existing server cart, checkout-core and canonical hosted checkout
advertisedCapabilities.requiredProof: Server repricing, stock handling, retained variant, idempotent retry, eligibility and truthful mock/sandbox mode; permitted branding data only

advertisedCapabilities.name: Shipping eligibility and delivery conditions
advertisedCapabilities.requiredProof: Rate returned for actual address. Mock fixture shows90 INR, not a production promise; delivery date absent without trusted result

advertisedCapabilities.name: Canonical buyer sign-in/register/Continue
advertisedCapabilities.requiredProof: Email/password, configured Turnstile, signup min8; successful identity session then explicit Continue to Trailmark or another account; validated tenant-bound OAuth redirect; no mandatory automatic email code

advertisedCapabilities.name: Profile/address/order ownership
advertisedCapabilities.owner: canonical buyer accounts / gateway scoped buyer routes
advertisedCapabilities.requiredProof: Normal auth, direct-owned-order read, cross-buyer denial, store-scoped history, address edit/add/default validation and persistence. UI screenshots do not prove any mutation

advertisedCapabilities.name: Genuine reviews
advertisedCapabilities.requiredProof: No reviews yet in mockup. Only published reviews may render when wired; no invented rating

advertisedCapabilities.name: Safety-critical gear fitting, regulated equipment and certification
advertisedCapabilities.requiredProof: Outside initial recreation scope; separate material product approval required

advertisedCapabilities.name: Activity booking, autonomous size recommendations, bundles, cross-merchant wallet or headless storefront
